276436691.description: This lot includes four assorted raw mineral gemstone specimens in natural, unpolished condition. It contains two pieces of black tourmaline with striated, columnar structures and dark metallic luster. There is one greenish fibrous mineral specimen, likely actinolite or a similar mineral. Also included is a large rough matrix rock with silvery metallic flecks, possibly containing pyrite or mica, showing gold and grey mineralization. All specimens exhibit typical surface texture, minor chips, and some adhering matrix material. Sizes range from small hand specimens to larger chunks. No branding or manufacturer information is present. These pieces are suitable for collectors, educational use, or metaphysical purposes.

276677259.description: This lot includes assorted mineral specimens: two polished agate slabs and one rough sodalite stone. The polished slabs feature blue-gray coloration with semi-translucent chalcedony areas, typical of blue agate. The rough stone displays a deep blue crystalline structure with a white matrix and dark inclusions, consistent with sodalite or lapis lazuli. Each piece is medium-sized, approximately palm-sized. The slabs have smooth, polished faces and natural rough backs. No brand or manufacturer markings. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects.
